title: Member enrolled
description: A member was enrolled in the Tenant's loyalty program, either ahead of the first order by an explicit call or by the first order itself. The event's `aggregate` is `member/<memberId>`. This schema describes the `data` member; the envelope is described in ../../messaging/README.md.

memberId.description: loyalty's own opaque id for the member, so a receiver can match the member across every event without the released reference.

externalRef.description: The Tenant's reference for the member, unique per Tenant and immutable.

enrolledAt.description: When the member was enrolled, in UTC.

via.description: ORDER when the first order enrolled the member; API when an explicit enrolment call did.
